title: Nutrition During Menopause
subtitle: Physiology, evidence, management options, and practical implications of nutrition during menopause.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for calcium, vitamin D, and macro-nutrient adjustments; moderate and emerging evidence for phytoestrogens and herbal supplements; limitations due to individual variability and inconsistent trial results for symptom management supplements.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
